Ordnance 0.4.6. Mods written for Rat's loader run. Armor Transmog opens with F8, and the search box takes text after you press Enter.

## What's new

**Rat mods run.** Deploy still uses Ordnance's own boot. You do not install Rat. Armor Transmog's picker opens on the ship. Press Enter, then type. Clicking the search box does not start typing.

**Mods that mention Chef still deploy.** A note that the mod needs Chef Shared Loader is not the loader itself. Side Holster, Night Vision, and Impatient Diver stay in the deploy.

**Backpack holster.** A mod that builds a Vector3 can hang gear on your back on the ship.

**F10 is unchanged.** Arrow keys move one row. Right arrow rebinds a key. Enter stays the chat key.

Sign in to Nexus Mods still says Coming soon. An API key in Settings is how update checks reach Nexus until Nexus issues a client id.

## What Ordnance does

**Import from your current mod manager.** One-click import from HD2 Arsenal and Echelon — plus the older HD2 mod manager, Vortex, and your Downloads folder, with names, on/off state, and options intact.

**Automatic update checking and (optionally) downloading.** Ordnance checks every mod against its source — AyakaMods, GitHub, GameBanana, ModWorkshop, and Nexus Mods — and, when you enable it, downloads and installs the ones it can fetch itself.

**One deploy, everything enabled.** Merge mods and generated stat-plan edits into a single sealed swap and a single boot script. No per-mod loader conflicts.

## Get it

| Platform | Download |
| --- | --- |
| Windows | `Ordnance-0.4.6-windows-x64-setup.exe` |
| Windows: no install | `Ordnance-0.4.6-windows-x64-portable.zip` |
| Linux (Debian/Ubuntu) | `Ordnance-0.4.6-linux-amd64.deb` |
| Linux (Fedora/openSUSE) | `Ordnance-0.4.6-linux-x86_64.rpm` |
| Linux: no install | `Ordnance-0.4.6-linux-x86_64.AppImage` |
| Linux: just the binary (needs WebKitGTK 4.1) | `Ordnance-0.4.6-linux-x64.tar.gz` |

**Browser extension:** `ordnance-extension-chrome-1.0.4.zip` or `ordnance-extension-firefox-1.0.4.zip`. Load it unpacked. On a Nexus Files tab, the button beside Manual download says Ordnance.

Found a problem? Open an issue: <https://github.com/Cavadus/ordnance/issues>
